source_scope: Twelve adjudication records including two existing-source rechecks and one protocol/result overlap; not twelve independent new studies

decisions.name: Everolimus
decisions.rationale: Optional model-qualified probe only. Separate excess-pathway branch A from prospectively qualified flux/function branch B; neither is established in the selected pair. Graded exposure, regeneration/recovery and delayed injury must be adjudicated.
decisions.stop_rule: No advancement without qualified branch-specific functional phenotype, faithful useful output, acceptable immediate/delayed safety, justified exposure and replication. No post-hoc switching between branches; material BUBR1 loss pauses review. Unresolved source units, model-only function or survivor/growth-rate artifacts cannot satisfy gates; imprecise results are held, not automatically rejected.

context_sources.arst1431: Tumour-claim boundary only; not direct counterevidence to constitutional rescue.
context_sources.jci_correction: Figure 2E provenance correction; does not specifically invalidate Figure 5 mTOR blots.
context_sources.balnis2025: Challenges a universal measured-excess gate; different compound/model, separate prospective flux-function hypothesis only.
context_sources.yamada2026: Yeast mechanism lead, not direct mammalian harm.
context_sources.pun2025: Developmental scope limit; no drug response.
context_sources.vanerp2016: Exposure-matrix limitation; clinical margin stays null.
context_sources.growth_registry: Selected uncontrolled follow-up; not generalized pediatric safety.
context_sources.balnis_supplement: Disputed concentration quarantined; qualitative branch B rationale remains indirect.
context_sources.transplant2025: Context-specific positive safety counterweight; not MVA safety.
context_sources.biomede2026: Mixed tumor evidence outside RMS; no general biomarker rule.

decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Hydroxychloroquine
decisions.rationale: Retain actual adult compound-combination signal while requiring compound-specific RMS flux/selectivity evidence. HCQ increased protein abundance at 100 micromolar for 2 h in late-passage stromal cells; this is not constitutional functional rescue or an exposure bridge.
decisions.stop_rule: Do not reopen without compound-specific flux/function, matched deficient-normal safety including delayed muscle/lysosomal injury and recovery, and exposure; no inference from protein accumulation or another lysosomal drug.

context_sources.goenka2025: Negative different-cancer randomized combination; not an RMS effect estimate.
context_sources.hcq_terminated_registry: Historical-control stopping record, not randomized efficacy.
context_sources.rms_tmz2018: Bafilomycin evidence must not be attributed to HCQ.

decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Pralatrexate
decisions.rationale: Optional documented fusion-positive RMS model hypothesis, not constitutional repair or assumed subject subtype.
decisions.stop_rule: No advance without subtype/comparator, matched exposure and deficient-normal safety; recurrence rules out durable-eradication claims.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Temsirolimus
decisions.rationale: Preserve different trial questions; prevent unsupported class-wide benefit claims.
decisions.stop_rule: No direct transfer to constitutional everolimus rescue or unqualified standard-of-care comparator.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Entinostat
decisions.rationale: Jurisdiction-aware eligibility does not repair model/schedule, multiplicity and exposure gaps.
decisions.stop_rule: No promotion without appropriate subtype, replicated benefit, schedule-matched exposure and deficient-normal assessment.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Vorinostat
decisions.rationale: Retain transient case benefit alongside progression, toxicity and negative PDX growth outcome.
decisions.stop_rule: Necrosis or target engagement alone cannot establish efficacy; require exposure and matched normal safety.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Niclosamide and TBX-screen compounds
decisions.rationale: Reformulation evidence tempers original PK failure but does not create a free RMS exposure bridge.
decisions.stop_rule: Verify product/jurisdiction and endogenous mechanism; no advancement from extrapolated EC50s or unmatched total-plasma comparisons.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Posaconazole
decisions.rationale: Actual growth inhibition retained; tissue injury and interactions undermine broad safety assumptions.
decisions.stop_rule: No advancement without justified free exposure, normal-cell function and interaction review; no paper-to-paper combination assembly.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: PP2A recruitment and chemical tools
decisions.rationale: Exclude from approved-drug shortlist; retain localized recruitment as an optional mechanistic control.
decisions.stop_rule: Alignment under arrest, isolated scaffold binding or disputed compound annotation cannot establish faithful division or drug eligibility.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Drug senolysis and HSP90 inhibition
decisions.rationale: Genetic BubR1 clearance evidence and other-model drug benefits do not establish drug-mediated constitutional rescue.
decisions.stop_rule: No generic lower-p21 or marker-clearance success criterion; require tissue-resolved viable function and chromosome safety.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

decisions.name: Ataluren/readthrough route
decisions.rationale: Retain mechanism-control lessons but no approved clinical candidate promotion or selected-pair functional evidence.
decisions.stop_rule: Endogenous RNA, actual traversal, full-length protein and function must pass separately; current regulatory eligibility also required.
decisions.v15_reopening_rule: Same requirements for all directions: qualified model/context, locked functional question, useful output, deficient-normal safety, relevant exposure and independent confirmation; no promotion by elimination.

additional_sources.finding: RAPA-EX-01 randomized 40 older adults to weekly sirolimus or placebo with exercise for 13 weeks. Primary ITT difference: -2.13 chair stands (95% CI -4.61 to 0.34; p=0.089). Complete-case/per-protocol estimates favored placebo.
additional_sources.limit: Exploratory, small, imputed missing outcomes, no multiplicity adjustment. Sirolimus, older adults and exercise differ from everolimus in MVA. Sensitivity analyses do not supersede the primary result.
additional_sources.decision: Reject a generic rapalog-to-muscle-function benefit assumption; retain direct function and schedule/recovery tests.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Published original protocol; selected design/outcome sections
additional_sources.finding: Original RAPA-EX-01 protocol names chair-stand performance and ACTRN12624000790549.
additional_sources.limit: Protocol and results are one study, not replication. Direct registry retrieval failed; amendment history and full statistical code were not audited.
additional_sources.decision: Report the primary outcome; do not elevate significant sensitivity findings into the primary claim.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Primary Figure 6, related methods/results and limitations
additional_sources.finding: HCQ delayed chromatin compaction/decompaction in CAOV3 cells at 33 micromolar (two independent experiments, blinded scoring); the tripolar-division trend was not significant. Nuclear extracts used 500 micromolar (three experiments).
additional_sources.limit: Tumour/extract systems and high nominal exposures do not establish harm at relevant deficient-normal exposure. Resistance screens do not prove one causal target.
additional_sources.decision: HCQ is not a selective autophagy control. Keep reserve; require separate chromosome/kinetic safety and orthogonal flux controls before reopening.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Primary methods, force results and discussion
additional_sources.finding: Young male rats receiving rapamycin showed reduced contractile force and glucose intolerance versus vehicle and pair-fed comparisons; eight rats per group.
additional_sources.limit: Pair-feeding began a week later. Route, compound, schedule and species differ; reduced Rictor is not proof of causal mTORC2 mediation.
additional_sources.decision: Measure force separately from mass, and retain metabolic feedback and recovery endpoints.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Final published primary methods, Figure 3 and limitations
additional_sources.finding: In adult female mice, exercise-associated grip-strength and myofiber gains persisted with rapamycin. Thirty-six runners were randomized across three groups; 14 non-runners formed a sedentary vehicle group.
additional_sources.limit: No sedentary drug groups; running volume differed. This final publication and its March preprint are one experiment. It does not establish MVA safety.
additional_sources.decision: Reject inevitable class-wide muscle harm; qualify compound, stage and schedule instead.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Primary K668/SIRT2 and NMN results, Figures 1/3/6
additional_sources.finding: SIRT2 overexpression improved survival in BubR1-hypomorphic mice; NMN increased BubR1 abundance in separate experiments. Nicotinamide inhibited sirtuin-associated effects in cell assays.
additional_sources.limit: Genetic overexpression survival is not NMN drug rescue. NMN, nicotinamide and nicotinic acid are distinct; abundance is not selected-allele function.
additional_sources.decision: Reopen NAD/SIRT2 only as a mechanistic comparison with measured residual functional protein; no new drug priority.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Primary abstract/highlights; full paper not retrieved
additional_sources.finding: SIRT2 deacetylated BUBR1 K250, but knockdown-associated acetylation did not substantially increase total BUBR1 or delay prometaphase-to-anaphase transition.
additional_sources.limit: Different residue and experimental context from K668; this does not refute the K668 study.
additional_sources.decision: Measure checkpoint timing and function instead of assuming every SIRT2 perturbation stabilizes useful BUBR1.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Primary summary, selected author-hosted methods and appended published correction; registry landing page uninformative
additional_sources.finding: Niacin-associated NAD restoration and muscle improvement were reported in a small adult mitochondrial-myopathy study with treated matched controls.
additional_sources.limit: Five patients, open-label design; active malignancy requiring treatment and severe treated kidney disease were excluded. Neither BUBR1 rescue nor MVA suitability was tested.
additional_sources.decision: Do not transfer the favorable result or dosing to MVA; require the full compound-specific chain.

correction.scope: COX/SDH human-sample incubation methods corrected; authors state data, analysis and conclusions unchanged.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Indexed primary abstract and selected indexed passages; direct PMC page blocked
additional_sources.finding: A randomized blinded study in 14 physically compromised older adults found no improvement in muscle or mitochondrial function with a combined NAD-precursor intervention.
additional_sources.limit: Combination, population and exposure differ from niacin monotherapy and MVA. Null results are not universal inefficacy.
additional_sources.decision: Preserve counterevidence to a generic NAD-to-function claim.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Official current oral-suspension label, sections 1/5/8/12; recheck of existing source
additional_sources.finding: Specified pediatric TSC indications coexist with infection, renal, metabolic and wound-healing warnings; uncontrolled growth follow-up is a favorable but limited observation.
additional_sources.limit: This formulation-specific label is not MVA approval, individual safety assessment or a tissue exposure bridge.
additional_sources.decision: Keep the favorable growth evidence with its comparator limitation; retain specialist exposure/safety review.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Indexed primary abstract; direct PubMed page blocked
additional_sources.finding: A 2026 prostate-cancer study reports BUB1B-dependent resistant tumour growth and CENP-E perturbation effects.
additional_sources.limit: Adult prostate cancer is not RMS or constitutional MVA. Abstract-level review cannot settle disputed kinase/scaffold mechanisms.
additional_sources.decision: Restoring abundance is not automatically tumour-safe. Preserve separate tumour and deficient-normal endpoints; no new inhibitor recommendation.

additional_sources.reading_depth: Primary Figure 6 and methods 4.5; recheck of existing source
additional_sources.finding: Late-passage stromal-cell BUBR1 fell after 24-hour everolimus exposure; early-passage response differed. Methods specify 50 nM at 24 hours and 100 nM at 3 hours.
additional_sources.limit: Protein abundance and cell state cannot establish deficient-normal function, target causality or a clinical margin.
additional_sources.decision: Retain passage/state matching and endogenous BUBR1/function monitoring. Do not import these concentrations as a recommended experiment or child dose.

correction_status: PubMed linked notices revealed the S71 published correction, inspected in the author-hosted PDF. COX/SDH incubation times were corrected; authors state data and conclusions unchanged. Selected publisher/metadata checks found no other decision-changing notice; exhaustive surveillance and registry amendment history remain unverified.
